fact: NeST, rolled out on 1 July 2023, has run 130,032 tenders for ministries, departments and agencies, according to PPRA director general Dennis Simba.
PPRA director general Dennis Simba said NeST had handled 130,032 tenders worth Sh14.9 trillion.

PPRA Director General Eliakim Maswi says the Public Procurement Act No. 10 of 2023, in force 17 June 2024, mandates use of the National e-Procurement System of Tanzania (NeST) for all procurement processes.
PPRA's chief executive says a government directive requires all procurement on Tanzania Mainland to be conducted through NeST only from 1 October 2023.
The Public Procurement Bill 2023, per PPRA's chief executive, mandates electronic systems in all procurement with no offline option, on pain of up to three years' jail or a TZS 10 million fine.
The Public Procurement Regulatory Authority says the National e-Procurement System of Tanzania (NeST), introduced in 2023, replaced paper tendering and handles tender submission online.
The Public Procurement Regulatory Authority says more than 219,000 tenders were processed through NeST over financial years 2023/24 and 2024/25.

PPRA Director General Dennis Simba told Parliament's Public Accounts Committee that the National e-Procurement System of Tanzania (NeST) now comprises six modules: e-registration, e-tendering, e-contract management, e-complaints, e-auction and e-payment.

Dennis Simba of PPRA said that through the e-payment module procuring entities can conduct the entire procurement process within NeST up to and including payment, with integration to government payment platforms done and the budget-system link being finalised.
By August 2026 the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority said NeST had facilitated 397,395 procurement proceedings worth 40.4tri/-.

NeST covers registration, tendering, evaluation, contract management, catalogues, auctions and payments, according to the article, and the Ministry of Finance's 2026/27 budget documentation says MUSE is integrated with NeST so procurement payments feed into financial administration.
